import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem normal_core_mono_and_contains {G : Type*} [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G) (hHK : H ≤ K) :
  H.normalCore ≤ K.normalCore ∧
    ∀ N : Subgroup G, Normal N → N ≤ H → N ≤ K.normalCore := by
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_mono hHK
  · intro N hN hNH
    letI : N.Normal := hN
    exact Subgroup.normal_le_normalCore.mpr (hNH.trans hHK)
